established_findings.text: On 14 March, the Larkspur Data Center (Building 2) lost utility power at 02:14 local time.
Normal service was restored at 06:34.
312 customers were affected.
Failover to Generator B was approved by Priya Raman, Operations Lead.
The utility fault was triggered by a storm.
Building 2 opened in 2017.
Building 2 houses four data halls with roughly 1,900 racks.
Building 1 was not affected by the incident.
The visitor parking lot has 14 additional spaces.
The campus is staffed 24/7 by a rotating team of operations engineers.
At 02:41, a utility feed lost alarm was raised for Building 2.
At 02:52, Generator B went online.
At 03:05, the utility provider was notified.
At 04:10, Generator B shut down and Generator A took the load.
At 08:05, the utility feed was restored and service was normal for all halls.
Both generators are rated at 2 MW.
The UPS system is rated for 15 minutes at full load.
Generator A was last serviced in January.
The UPS battery strings were installed in 2019.
213 customers experienced degraded or no service.
41 customers were premium tier.
Support received 1,208 tickets during and after the event.
The median first-response time to tickets was 22 minutes.
A refuel truck was dispatched at 03:40.
The weather station recorded clear skies, no precipitation, and no wind above 12 km/h on the night of 13 to 14 March.
The utility provider attributed the feed loss to a transformer failure at Substation 7.
Sunrise on 14 March was at 06:12.
38 premium-tier customers were affected.

unresolved_conflicts.summary: UPS duration discrepancy: 15 minutes vs 9 minutes
unresolved_conflicts.what_would_resolve_it: Clarify the actual UPS runtime during the outage.
Confirm the exact time service was fully restored.

unresolved_conflicts.summary: Failover approval discrepancy: Priya Raman vs Daniel Okafor
Generator B fuel capacity discrepancy: 11 hours vs 3 hours at 20%
unresolved_conflicts.what_would_resolve_it: Verify the actual tank capacity and fuel level.

root_cause_statement: No root cause is confirmed; the cause remains under investigation.
conclusion: The Larkspur Data Center experienced a 4‑hour 20‑minute outage on 14 March due to a storm‑induced transformer failure that cut utility power. Backup systems, including UPS and generators, restored service by 06:34, affecting 312 customers, with 38 premium tier customers impacted. Several factual inconsistencies remain unresolved, preventing a definitive root cause determination.
